method: 15 targeted direct IB Guide guidance-to-visible-Learn comparisons; selected topical pages of Hodder Third Edition were extracted for C1.3, C2.1, C2.2, D3.1 and D4.1, not line-by-line read or independently signed off. Every remaining textbook-depth comparison is still pending.

records.sourceBasis: Direct comparison of numbered IB Guide statement/guidance against student-visible main teaching at pinned source SHA; no automatic claim of complete scientific verification.
records.requiredContentParaphrase: Distinguish feedback that stabilizes a variable from feedback that reinforces an ongoing event; give one biological case of each.
records.visibleCurrentCoverage: Both cases are explained: glucose-regulated insulin secretion and the pre-ovulatory oestradiol–LH surge.
records.materialGapOrTeachingIssue: No material omission demonstrated in this targeted check. Visual was automatically suggested but not compulsory.
records.originalRepairAdvice: retain concise explanation; optional two-column feedback diagram only if learner testing justifies it
records.reviewFinding: conceptually aligned in targeted guide-and-chapter comparison; not independently approved
